provenance.method: read-only DocumentSummary and Document reads by id from a signed-in staff session; nothing was written to the tenant
provenance.rule: A document is stock only at a stock path (a module's /DefaultSystem/ folder, or $/Samples/) whose payload fingerprint (SHA-256 and byte count of the decoded Document.Data) matches. Custom roots and pathless documents are excluded. IsSystem is not read: it is unreliable on the source tenant.
